password: To reset your password, press Ctrl + Alt + Delete and choose Change Password. If you've forgotten it, contact your IT administrator.
vpn: Verify your internet connection, restart the VPN client, and sign in again with your latest credentials.
printer: Check that the printer is powered on, connected to the network, and set as your default printer.
wifi: Restart your Wi-Fi adapter, reconnect to the network, and verify that Airplane Mode is turned off.
email: Verify your Outlook credentials, internet connection, and mailbox configuration.
